name: 🍔 Buffalo Chicken Sliders
tagline: Saucy buffalo chicken on soft brioche rolls with melty cheese, baked as one pull-apart tray.

items.name: Butter, melted (2 for sauce, 2 for tops)

steps.text: Oven to 375°F. Simmer the chicken in salted water until 165°F, about 15 minutes (or use a rotisserie chicken).
Shred the chicken with two forks.
Stir the Frank's with 2 Tbsp melted butter; toss with the chicken. Taste and add more sauce for the grown-ups.
Slice the whole sheet of rolls in half sideways without pulling them apart. Bottom half goes in a 9×13 dish.
Layer chicken, then cheese, then the top half.
Brush the tops with butter mixed with garlic powder. Bake covered 10 minutes, uncovered 5.
Pull apart and serve with ranch and celery.

kid_jobs.job: Make a mild version for anyone who doesn't like spicy

chef_tip: Toss half the chicken in sauce and keep a plain corner for anyone who wants mild. Mix the Frank's with butter so it clings instead of soaking the bun.
make_ahead: Cook and shred the chicken up to 2 days ahead.
leftovers: Buffalo chicken wraps or over a salad with ranch.
swaps: Pepper jack or provolone instead of mozzarella
serve_with: Celery, carrots and ranch; tater tots

game_plan.what: Oven to 375°F. Chicken simmering in salted water.
Shred the chicken; toss with Frank's and butter.
Kids layer rolls, chicken and cheese in the dish.
Garlic butter on top; bake covered.
Foil off. Kids cut celery, set out ranch.
